newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung seeks Volkswagen RV technology.
newsitem.headline: Samsung seeks Volkswagen RV technology.

text.p: Samsung Group is negotiating with Volkswagen AG to secure technology for recreational vehicles and small trucks, Samsung officials said on Monday.

"Volkswagen is one of several companies we are talking to for a technical tie-up. We expect a partner to be chosen by early next year," said a spokesman of Samsung Commercial Vehicle Co, a unit of Samsung Group.
The other firms were only identified as "European companies".

Samsung Commercial, which currently makes large trucks, plans to start producing trucks capable of carrying up to one tonne of cargo in the second half of 1998 and recreational vehicles the following year, he said.
Samsung Motors Inc, another unit of Samsung Group, has been preparing to start commercial production of passenger cars from 1998 in a technical tie-up with Nissan Motor Co of Japan.
